name: Plan Code Runner
description: Executes an implementation plan step by step: reads a plan JSON file made by a planner agent, hands each step to a coder agent, collects the coder's work report for the next step, and when the coder reports a deviation/error, asks the planner agent to update the plan before continuing.

commands.title: Run implementation plan
commands.description: Runs a saved implementation plan end to end. Input must be an object: {"planPath":"absolute path to the plan .", "coderAgentName":"name of the saved coder agent (default 'coder')", "plannerAgentName":"name of the saved planner agent (default 'Implementation Plan Architect')", "startStep":1, "maxSteps":40, "maxPlanUpdates":8}. The extension loads the plan file, executes each step through the coder agent, passes every completed step's report (what was done, files created/modified, outputs) as context to the next step, and on a coder deviation/error sends the deviation plus the work already done to the planner agent, writes the updated plan back to planPath, and re-runs the affected step. Returns a JSON run report with per-step reports, plan revisions and final status.

commands.title: Preview plan steps
commands.description: Reads a plan JSON file and returns its step list without executing anything. Input must be an object: {"planPath":"absolute path to the plan ."} or a plain path string. Use to check that a plan file exists and is well formed before running it.
